custom_preconds:
• Sign in as Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button; you appear as "Admin ShopView").
  • An Approved work order with a Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and two lines with no technician picked on them. Example: the work order of customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History".
  • No such work order? Click Create Work Order, pick a customer and asset, Save. Add two lines with New Line (Status "Authorized", no technician). On the work order's left card set Lead Technician.
  • Two more technicians at this location (e.g. Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Work Orders, click the All tab, then Board View. Click Search and type the customer's name.
  2. Drag the work order's card from the lead's column (e.g. Esther Howard) to another technician's column (e.g. Ralph Edwards). If asked "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?", click Keep Shifts.
  3. Open the work order. Click ⋮ at the top right (next to New Line), then Audit Log.
  4. In the Work Order Log, read the newest "Lead tech changed" entry. Close the log.
  5. Click the first line's name. In Edit Line, remove the technician shown (x), add another one (e.g. Dana Ortiz), click Save & Close.
  6. Click the line's number (1), then Audit log. Read the newest entry. Close it.
  7. Back on Board View, open the card's More actions > Reassign lead technician, pick the first lead again (e.g. Esther Howard) and confirm. Repeat steps 3 and 4.
  8. On the work order's left card change Lead Technician (e.g. to Ralph Edwards). Repeat steps 3 and 4.
